property_summary: After a valid fallback call with msg.value == 10 ether, the contract's balance is zero if and only if block.number % 15 == 0; the bug reverses the condition, making balance zero when block.number % 15 != 0.
change_summary: Change block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0, reversing the condition under which the balance is transferred.
